One source to a campaign of reviewable drafts.
Deterministic notification planning: recipients by permission class, urgency, transactional status, quiet hours, digest, mute, unsubscribe, rate limits and dedupe. A model never decides these.
FactPack claim assessment: snippets are unverified, first-party claims attributed, corroboration across hosts, contradictions kept and excluded from drafts, injection text never a claim.

Like-for-like performance comparison: only verified posts, unavailable is never zero, at least 5 posts per arm, a material difference, counter-evidence kept; the output is a non-causal hypothesis, never a rule.
